  m="$arg"
  if [[ "$arg" == *"https://slack.com"* ]]; then
    m="${arg//https:\/\/slack.com/$svc/slack}"
  elif [[ "$arg" == *"https://api.slack.com"* ]]; then
    m="${arg//https:\/\/api.slack.com/$svc/slack}"
  elif [[ "$arg" == *"https://api.linear.app"* ]]; then
    m="${arg//https:\/\/api.linear.app/$svc/linear}"
  elif [[ "$arg" == *"https://api.box.com/2.0"* ]]; then
    m="${arg//https:\/\/api.box.com\/2.0/$svc/box/2.0}"
  elif [[ "$arg" == *"https://api.box.com"* ]]; then
    m="${arg//https:\/\/api.box.com/$svc/box}"
  elif [[ "$arg" == *"https://upload.box.com/api/2.0"* ]]; then
    m="${arg//https:\/\/upload.box.com\/api\/2.0/$svc/box/2.0}"
  elif [[ "$arg" == *"https://upload.box.com"* ]]; then
    m="${arg//https:\/\/upload.box.com/$svc/box}"
  elif [[ "$arg" == *"https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3"* ]]; then
    m="${arg//https:\/\/www.googleapis.com\/calendar\/v3/$svc/calendar}"
  fi
  new_args+=("$m")
done

fi
